prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” AI video ad maker — the right choice depends on what you need (realistic AI presenters vs. fast social clips, budget, scale, languages, platform specs). Below is a short guide plus recommended tools for common needs (based on capabilities known up to mid‑2024). Tell me which scenario fits you and I’ll recommend one specific tool and workflow.

Quick decision guide (one‑line picks)
- Best for realistic AI presenters and polished corporate ads: Synthesia
- Best for converting long videos or blogs into short social ads automatically: Pictory
- Best all‑round, template‑driven social ads + branding (beginner‑friendly): Canva
- Best for rapid, template‑based social/video ads with ad-focused tools: InVideo / Promo.com
- Best for creative, generative editing and novel effects: Runway
- Best for easy browser editing with strong auto‑subtitles and collaboration: VEED.io
- Best low‑cost, simple batch/video ad maker: Designs.ai or Lumen5
- Best if you need an AI presenter alternative to Synthesia: HeyGen / Elai.io / Movio

Short pros/cons summary
- Synthesia: realistic avatars, supports many languages, enterprise features and brand controls. Higher price; limited creative/scene variability vs. full filming.
- Pictory: excellent for turning articles/long-form video into short ads, auto-highlights, captions. Great for repurposing content.
- Canva: huge template library, brand kit, simple animation and resizing for ad platforms; not as advanced for AI avatars or generative footage.
- InVideo / Promo / Lumen5: fast templates tuned for social ad formats and CTAs; good for small teams and quick A/B creatives.
- Runway: cutting-edge generative and frame-level editing; powerful for creative ads but steeper learning curve.
- VEED: easy subtitle, translations, simple AI tools and team collaboration; good for quick edits and repurposing.
- Designs.ai: affordable all-in-one with automated script-to-video features; less photorealistic than top enterprise tools.

How to choose (quick checklist)
- Platform & format (TikTok/Reels vs YouTube vs display ads)
- Length & cadence (6–15s vs 30–60s vs longer)
- Need for human presenters (real actor vs AI avatar vs text + visuals)
- Language & voiceover requirements
- Volume & scale (single ad vs hundreds for AB testing)
- Budget (free/basic vs subscription vs enterprise)
- Brand controls (fonts, logos, approvals, watermarking)

If you want a tailored recommendation, tell me:
- Platform(s) you’ll run the ad on
- Target length(s) and number of variants
- Do you need a humanlike presenter (AI avatar) or voiceover only?
- Budget (free/cheap <$50/month / mid $50–300 / enterprise)
With that I’ll pick the best tool and outline a simple workflow (script → assets → creation → optimize) and, if you want, draft a 15‑ or 30‑second ad script.

Which platform and style are you targeting?
